auxiliary_suffix.reason: The conditioning polymer at rank 25 prevents an earlier auxiliary suffix. Rank 26 is a colorant and cannot establish the boundary. Rank 27 is the earliest qualifying functional marker, followed by independent preservative and fragrance functions without a later competing vehicle or structurant.

counter_signal: Silicone-led is plausible if the aqueous/hydrocarbon vehicles mainly deliver the silicone film.
Water-based is weakened because water is not leading and both the hydrocarbon and silicone arms have affirmative functional support.
base.reason: Joint backbone evidence extends beyond the first two ingredients: the hydrocarbon carrier, aqueous vehicle/cosolvent/humectant route, silicone carrier/gum route, and solubilizer/emulsifier/rheology network support an integrated mixed architecture. This is affirmative multi-route evidence, not hybrid by ingredient count or uncertainty. There is no intact botanical oil; PEG-60 Hydrogenated Castor Oil is a derivative.
base.unresolved: Phase continuity, carrier ratios, premix construction and silicone grades are undisclosed.

counter_signal: Light: the hydrocarbon/aqueous/solvent delivery system could leave a relatively small silicone load.
Rich: silicone gum and rheology/conditioning polymers are affirmative retained-system signals, but their functions and unspecified amounts do not establish a principal rich structured coating.
weight.reason: B1/B5 favor medium through the coherent dimethicone/dimethiconol conditioning route with additional modified-silicone and polymer conditioning, carried in the mixed solvent/aqueous system. The lighter delivery architecture is real but does not erase the multi-component conditioning route; B6 lacks a dominant rich-system argument.
weight.unresolved: No quantities, silicone grades, dried residual-load measurements or equal-dose hair sensory evidence; rheology is not equivalent to deposited hair-film dominance.

counter_signal: The aqueous/humectant route can involve fiber interactions that this classification does not measure; water entry is not the admitted whole-oil penetration endpoint.
penetration_potential.reason: Affirmative silicone-conditioning and polymer/emollient architecture supports the surface-led estimate. The modified castor solubilizer is not an intact positive whole-oil anchor. This does not claim universal silicone exclusion from fibers.
penetration_potential.unresolved: No exact-formula uptake study, proportions or application-specific delivery observation; blend/laboratory-to-retail extrapolation remains untested.

auxiliary_suffix.reason: The conditioning polymer at rank 25 prevents an earlier auxiliary suffix. Rank 26 is a colorant and cannot establish the boundary. Rank 27 is the earliest qualifying functional marker, followed by independent preservative and fragrance functions without a later competing vehicle or structurant.

counter_signal: Silicone-led is plausible if the aqueous/hydrocarbon vehicles mainly deliver the silicone film.
Water-based is weakened because water is not leading and both the hydrocarbon and silicone arms have affirmative functional support.
base.reason: Joint backbone evidence extends beyond the first two ingredients: the hydrocarbon carrier, aqueous vehicle/cosolvent/humectant route, silicone carrier/gum route, and solubilizer/emulsifier/rheology network support an integrated mixed architecture. This is affirmative multi-route evidence, not hybrid by ingredient count or uncertainty. There is no intact botanical oil; PEG-60 Hydrogenated Castor Oil is a derivative.
base.unresolved: Phase continuity, carrier ratios, premix construction and silicone grades are undisclosed.

counter_signal: Light: the hydrocarbon/aqueous/solvent delivery system could leave a relatively small silicone load.
Rich: silicone gum and rheology/conditioning polymers are affirmative retained-system signals, but their functions and unspecified amounts do not establish a principal rich structured coating.
weight.reason: B1/B5 favor medium through the coherent dimethicone/dimethiconol conditioning route with additional modified-silicone and polymer conditioning, carried in the mixed solvent/aqueous system. The lighter delivery architecture is real but does not erase the multi-component conditioning route; B6 lacks a dominant rich-system argument.
weight.unresolved: No quantities, silicone grades, dried residual-load measurements or equal-dose hair sensory evidence; rheology is not equivalent to deposited hair-film dominance.

counter_signal: The aqueous/humectant route can involve fiber interactions that this classification does not measure; water entry is not the admitted whole-oil penetration endpoint.
penetration_potential.reason: Affirmative silicone-conditioning and polymer/emollient architecture supports the surface-led estimate. The modified castor solubilizer is not an intact positive whole-oil anchor. This does not claim universal silicone exclusion from fibers.
penetration_potential.unresolved: No exact-formula uptake study, proportions or application-specific delivery observation; blend/laboratory-to-retail extrapolation remains untested.
